versions.description: Lucide icons replace react-icons; ClickableHtml lists its data events; nested events no longer bubble

codemods.description: Rewrite react-icons and stale Ant Design icon names to semantic or Lucide names using the v7-0-0/react-icons-to-lucide.json table, and report glyph judgement calls, unmapped names and runtime-only icon sources (the @lowdefy/icons-react-icons compatibility set covers stored names and brand icons).

List the events each ClickableHtml block's HTML fires in its new dataEvents property (from data-event attributes and the block's events), mark data-changing events that use data-confirm as confirm: true, and report HTML built from data that inserts values unescaped.

Add bubble: true only to nested events whose outer event reads a value the inner event sets, copy AgGrid onRowClick state setup into cell control events that relied on it, and report the nested events left with the new innermost-only behaviour.

versions.description: Vite + Hono server migration (plugin ESM exports, Auth.js imports, provider-neutral file blocks, request timeout, plugin type overrides)

codemods.description: Convert custom plugin packages for the unbundled Node ESM server: exports subpaths must resolve to files (fixes ERR_UNSUPPORTED_DIR_IMPORT), next-auth imports move to @auth/core, next/* imports and NEXT_PUBLIC_* reads are removed.

Optional: rename the deprecated S3UploadButton/S3UploadPhoto/S3UploadDragger/S3Download blocks to the provider-neutral Upload/UploadPhoto/UploadDragger/Download blocks, and s3PostPolicyRequestId/s3GetPolicyRequestId to uploadPolicyRequestId/downloadPolicyRequestId (also on TiptapInput, TiptapMentionInput, and AgentChat attachments). The aliases keep working; this silences deprecation warnings.

Add config.requestTimeout: 0 to keep the v5 request duration. v6 cuts requests off after 30 seconds by default (v5 had no timeout), and a cut-off request shows a generic error while the rest of the page renders from the requests that finished.

Report-only: after a build, list custom plugin types that override a Lowdefy built-in type of the same name. A plugin holding a v5 copy of a built-in keeps its v5 behaviour and can break v6 blocks without an error. Each override needs author review: keep, delete the copy, or rename.

versions.description: MongoDBUpdateOne throws a no-match error by default; opt out per request with disableNoMatchError

codemods.description: Add disableNoMatchError: true to existing MongoDBUpdateOne requests to preserve pre-5.5.0 behavior, with a per-request report for author review. No-op for apps using @lowdefy/community-plugin-mongodb.

versions.description: AgGrid built-in cell renderer types (tag, avatar, link, date, boolean, progress, number) + ellipsis + align

codemods.description: Report-only: detect cellRenderer HTML patterns that could migrate to cell.type. Each column requires human review and author sign-off.

versions.description: Antd v6 upgrade, layout grid changes, dayjs migration

Convert bordered: false to variant: borderless
Rename deprecated properties and events (visible, dotPosition, etc.)
Tabs tabPosition to tabPlacement with value mapping
Notification message property renamed to title
Divider type/orientation dual rename with value mapping
Button type/danger to color + variant mapping
Detect public/styles.less and map Less variables to antd tokens
Detect custom date format strings for dayjs compatibility
Remove meta.styles from custom block plugins, add direct CSS imports
Rename xxl breakpoint key to 2xl
Rename gutter to gap and contentGutter to contentGap
Drop content* prefix from layout properties
Rename layout.align to layout.selfAlign
Rename _moment operator to _dayjs
Report thresholds usage in _dayjs.humanizeDuration
Migrate responsive style breakpoints to Tailwind classes
Replace removed Comment block with Flex + Avatar + Paragraph composition
Migrate custom block plugin architecture: types.js, meta.js, withBlockDefaults
Replace Emotion-style nested CSS selectors (&:hover, & > *) with Tailwind classes
Replace removed AgGrid*Dark block types with auto-detecting light variants
Remove header.theme, sider.theme, menu.theme from page layout blocks and migrate nested style props
Move react, react-dom, and antd from dependencies to peerDependencies in custom block plugins
